data.name: Islah
data.gender_notes: Islah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: To make right, to reform, to correct a wrong or error. The name Islah carries the meaning “To make right or correct” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Islah usually hope their child will grow to embody to make right or correct and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To guide towards the right path
data.etymology: Islah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To make right or correct.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Islah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إصلاح
in_arabic.meaning: تعديل و اصلاح، جبران خسارت، احياء و تعمير
in_arabic.long_meaning: إصلاح هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ص-ل-ح' والذي يعني التصحيح، الإصلاح، والجبر. في القرآن الكريم، يرتبط الإصلاح بالتقوى وطاعة الله. اسم إصلاح يعبر عن الرغبة في تحسين الأمور وتصحيحها، ويحمل دلالات إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: اصلاح
in_urdu.meaning: اصلاح، درست کرنا، بحال کرنا، مرمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اصلاح ایک عربی मूल نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے درست کرنا، اصلاح کرنا، اور جبران خسارت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ تقوای اور اللہ کی طاعت سے وابستہ ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں، اصلاح نام خوبی اور اچھائی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इसलाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: इसलाह नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुधार करना, ठीक करना, और मरम्मत करना। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है, जहां यह नाम अच्छे गुणों और नैतिकता की सुधार से जुड़ा है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इसलाह नाम शांति और समृद्धि की कामना का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: إصلاح
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کلتور کې، د إصلاح نوم معنی د سمونځ، اصلاح، او ښه ګټه څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمو کې د دیني او کلتورلي ارزښتونو د ودې لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Islah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Islah originates from the Arabic root 'ṣ-l-ḥ', meaning to correct, reform, or make amends. In the Quran, Islah is associated with righteousness and obedience to God. Historically, the name has been used across Islamic cultures to signify moral improvement and spiritual growth. It reflects a desire to better oneself and others, embodying values of compassion and justice.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: إصلاح

data.cultural_impact: The name Islaah has significant cultural implications, especially within the Islamic community. The concept of Islaah (to reform or to set right) is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings, emphasizing the importance of continuous personal and societal improvement. This name can be seen as a constant reminder and call to action for individuals and communities to strive for a better world, by addressing the root causes of problems and working towards solutions.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Islaah represents the process of seeking forgiveness, repentance, and guidance from Allah (God), with the ultimate goal of bringing one's actions in alignment with His will and pleasing Him. This spiritual seeking for guidance and self-improvement is a fundamental aspect of Islamic belief, and the name Islaah encapsulates the importance of this journey towards achieving a closer relationship with the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "To make right or correct" symbolizes To make right, to reform, to correct a wrong or error. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Islah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of to make right or correct.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Islah was mentioned in the Hadith as a virtuous woman. The name Islah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Islah was known for her piety and charity in the early Islamic community.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Islah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Zainab Islah in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Islah, which means "To make right or correct". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
